data.text:
[8:55PM] #Imota_Ikorodu #TrafficUpdate 

There is smooth and improved vehicular movement from Sabo Roundabout through Sabo Onimalu, Alaka, Low Cost Housing Estate, Jendol, NASFAT, Sawmill, down to Itamaga.
From Itamaga through LASUSTECH Gate, Lucky Fibre, Maya, and Adamo to Imota, traffic is moving even faster.
Similarly, the route from Itamaga through Idiroko, Cele, Gbaga, Omitoro, Eleshin, and down to Elepe is experiencing better movement.
The return journey from Elepe back through Eleshin, Omitoro, Gbaga, Cele, Idiroko to Itamaga is flowing perfectly.
Traffic from Itamaga back to Sawmill, NASFAT, Jendol, Low Cost Housing Estate, Alaka, Sabo Onimalu, and finally to Sabo Roundabout is also running very smoothly.
